description: Source code implementing SIMD-accelerated image convolution functions using ARM NEON intrinsics, including horizontal and vertical convolution routines for the skia graphics library.

methods.name: AccumRemainder
methods.description: Accumulates the remainder pixels' contributions for convolution using NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally_Neon
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single row with NEON optimization.

methods.name: Convolve4RowsHorizontally_Neon
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on four rows simultaneously with NEON.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically_Neon
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution on multiple rows with NEON acceleration.
